content.title: How to watch Alabama vs. Michigan men’s basketball: Sweet 16 TV channel and streaming options for March 27
content.text: The No. 4-seed Alabama Crimson Tide (25-9) head into a Sweet 16 matchup against the No. 1 Michigan Wolverines (33-3) on Friday at 7:50 p.m. ET as the NCAA Tournament continues at United Center airing on TBS.How to watch Alabama Crimson Tide vs. Michigan Wolverines Venue: United Center Time: 7:50 p.m. ET TV: TBS Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. Alabama vs. Michigan odds Spread: Michigan -9.5 (-111), Alabama +9.5 (-114) Favorite Moneyline: Michigan -546 Underdog Moneyline: Alabama +388 Total: 172.5 Total Over Odds: -112 Total Under Odds: -112 Odds provided by BetMGM.Stats to know Michigan outscores opponents by 17.8 points per game (scoring 87.4 per game to rank ninth in college basketball while giving up 69.6 per outing to rank 65th in college basketball) and has a +643 scoring differential overall. Michigan makes 9.2 three-pointers per game (76th in college basketball) compared to its opponents’ 8.2. It shoots 36.6% from deep while its opponents hit 30.8% from long range. Alabama puts up 91.6 points per game (first in college basketball) while giving up 82.5 per outing (351st in college basketball). It has a +309 scoring differential and outscores opponents by 9.1 points per game. Alabama knocks down 4.7 more threes per contest than the opposition, 12.8 (second-most in college basketball) compared to its opponents’ 8.1.
